headline: Congress takes a breather after a marathon week of legislative action, reconvening in pro forma sessions next week!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate held a brief pro forma session on Friday, October 9, meeting at 1:30 p.m. and adjourning just 39 seconds later to continue the recess. No substantive business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House held a 2-minute session on Friday, October 9, during which it introduced 27 new bills and 4 resolutions. Nine committee reports on Small Business Administration-related legislation were filed, but no votes were taken.

onTheFloor.title: Clarify and expand the authority of the Assistant Secretary for Management of the Department of Veterans Affairs
Require the Small Business Administration to maintain a website for small business concerns relating to onshoring manufacturing capacity
Require the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to disseminate information on foreign adversary conduct harming small businesses
Require quarterly reports on small business investment companies
Improve the loan guaranty program and enhance access to affordable capital for small manufacturers
Provide interim partial payment to small business contractors requesting equitable adjustments due to construction contract changes
